tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Lists every page of a kept site, or of a preview given its draft_id, in one answer with no paging. Each line is a page's address and title, indented by depth, and on a kept site the date it last changed. A kept site lists the top-level pages first, then each deeper level, in alphabetical order of ad

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Reads one page of a kept site, or of a preview given its draft_id. It returns the page's address, its title and its full markdown; on a kept site also the date it last changed and the settings at the top of the page, as key: value lines. tools.name: find_references
tools.description: Finds the passages in a site that state a fact, and returns each with its page address, its line numbers and its text, best match first. tools.name: history
tools.description: Lists a kept site's numbered versions, newest first, a page of them at a time: each line is the version number, what changed, who changed it and the date. tools.name: site_status
tools.description:
Reports the state of one site, or of a preview given its draft_id, at the moment of the call.
For a kept site: its name and address; whether readers can see it, and at which version; whether a publish is under way; when it was last published; whether the last publish failed, and at which file and li

tools.name: propose_edit
tools.description: Stages a set of page changes (create, update, delete or move) for review, without keeping any of them. On a kept site it returns a link that shows the site with the changes for 24 hours and can be shared, the reference apply_edit takes to keep them, and any links the changes would break; readers see

tools.name: apply_edit
tools.description: Keeps changes. On a kept site it takes the proposal_id that propose_edit returned, or that site_status lists, and saves that staged set as the site's next numbered version, all at once or not at all. It does not publish: readers see the change after publish. A staged set is not kept if someone else

tools.name: publish
tools.description: Publishes a kept site: its latest kept version goes out to readers at the site's address and replaces what they saw. It answers at once, the publish starts in about a minute and readers see it shortly after, and site_status shows the progress. Only kept versions go out, so changes from propose_edit

tools.name: rollback
tools.description: Puts a kept site, or chosen pages of it, back to how they were at an earlier version. The result is saved as a new version, so no version is lost and a rollback can be undone by going back again; when nothing would change, no version is saved. tools.name: create_preview
tools.description:
Creates a temporary preview site from pages already converted to markdown, and returns its link and its draft_id. The preview belongs to no one until somebody keeps it, and expires if nobody does. The result says what to check, page by page, before the link is shared.

tools.description: Keeps a preview nobody has kept yet as a site in the signed-in person's own account, at the web address named by subdomain.
